mission.text: You are trying Taskly, a small web app for keeping a to-do list, for the first time. You have a handful of errands and chores to keep track of this week. Use Taskly for them the way you would actually use a list app, until you have decided whether you would keep using it. Report what worked, and describe anything that behaved differently from what you expected, in plain terms, saying what you did and what you saw.

detectedQuotes.D3: the filters appeared reversed: active showed the completed tasks, while completed showed the unfinished tasks.

unresolved: editing call dentist to book dentist appointment did not save. i clicked save twice, but the task later reverted.

supported.quote: pressing enter saved a new task but did not save an edited task; i had to click save.
clear completed immediately removed completed items without confirmation.
most importantly, refreshing the page erased the three unfinished tasks as well.
i hesitated at the edit because there was no cancel option, but the main reason i would not keep using taskly is that the list did not survive a page refresh.
